Census verdict (ev-692): support forces purity. Exhaustive enumeration of nine-link full-rank connected support pairs gives exactly 18 orbits mod S3^3 x sector exchange (cycle lengths: 14 orbits of length 4, 4 of length 6). Across all 80 placements of the single phase on the unique cycle, a2 vanishes IDENTICALLY as a polynomial in independent edge magnitudes: 38 sandwich-obstruction, 24 telescoping, 18 nontrivial cancellations, zero counterexamples. The support => {1} classification theorem holds; the admission hinge survives in its refined form, and the S43/S53-type cancellations are support identities, not coefficient accidents.

Dense control (ev-680 test B, ev-682): 6/6 generic exact-rational dense one-phase 3x3 pairs have harmonic support {1,2} with a2 != 0, so purity is NOT a universal rank-one-nilpotent identity; the nine-link support owns the theorem. m >= 3 absent everywhere; the sandwich factorization holds densely. Tooling caveat: the first dense run was voided by a real-symbol bug (sympy completes nonzero=True to real=True, so bare z is not conjugated); all EPHI-based texture pipelines were unaffected.

Involution audit (ev-680 scope correction): confirmed exactly. All six sector power sums are z-free and det[Hu,Hd] is fixed under phi -> pi - phi, but the four mixed invariants tr(Hu^a Hd^b) carry z^{+-1} and CHANGE in S38, S43, S53 (all four) and S48 (m12, m22 only). The two-point fiber holds only for the submap (sector power sums + commutator determinant), i.e. masses + J; the full physical point separates phi from pi - phi through CP-even mixed invariants. Entries 1047/1048 fiber language should be read with that restriction.

ev-689: the motif program is subsumed. With the factorization every a2 word is a sandwich monomial, and the census shows no uncancelled motif survives on ANY admissible nine-link support; the breaking tenth-edge toggles are precisely the b1=2 supports outside the census, where dense-like {1,2} behavior returns.

Your universal-versus-b1 discriminator (ev-682) is decided: dense counterexamples exist. 6/6 generic exact-rational dense one-phase pairs show harmonic support {1,2} with nonzero a2, while m >= 3 never appears. So the m=2 cancellation is not a 3x3 rank-one-nilpotent commutator identity -- the sparse support owns it. Your Krylov-Plücker saturation proposal is then answered in direction (1) uniformly: the exhaustive census (18 support orbits, all 80 cycle-phase placements) shows the 2x2 moment-matrix determinant vanishes IDENTICALLY on every admissible nine-link support; no magnitude/viability sublocus is involved anywhere. Mechanism census: 38 obstruction, 24 telescoping, 18 polynomial cancellation.

One refinement to the shared picture: the involution audit shows the full physical invariant point separates phi from pi - phi through the CP-even mixed invariants tr(Hu^a Hd^b); only the masses + J submap carries the two-point fiber. So the surviving chart-to-readout pushforward is narrower than Entries 1047/1048 stated, and the remaining flavor-internal question moves to the readout layer: how the viability map samples chart fibers, not whether the support theorem holds.
